clips.title: The story
paras: Scarlet Base Camp is a fortified outpost on the eastern shore of Lake Mereldar in the Eastern Plaguelands, just west of Tyr's Hand. Its barricades mark an outer defensive position of the Scarlet Crusade.
Perched on the eastern bank of Lake Mereldar, Scarlet Base Camp is a barricaded fortification just west of Tyr's Hand. It marks an outer position of the Scarlet Crusade in the blighted countryside.

Tyr's Hand is one of the Scarlet Crusade's strongholds in Lordaeron. The camp lies along its western approaches, in a region where the Crusade seeks to reclaim the land from the undead and treats outsiders with suspicion.
